props.text:
Market structure shift observed: was aiming for 7/7 lunch slams, but pattern evolved to brunch slams. QQQ/SPX showing early-morning selloffs (1:53–2:17 AM brunch-time hits).

Charts show ~30pt QQQ decline from 708 to 680.68 (01:53Z), continued decline to 677.32 (02:17Z), and recurring SPX intraday volatility with marked sell-off zones.
